name: Gratitude Jar
description: Write one good thing a day and drop it in the jar. Tap the jar to pull out a happy memory at random.
prompt: A gratitude jar: write one good thing each day and watch a folded paper note drop into a glass jar, then tap the jar to pull out a random happy memory with its date.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Escribe una cosa buena al día y échala al bote. Toca el bote para sacar un recuerdo bonito al azar.
